Graceful Isolation Lattice and SLO Escort Hotfix

Hotfix: introduce lattice-based tenant isolation to enable staged soft-shedding and SLO Escort to preserve priority during regional failovers. Backwards compatible; feature gated. Includes telemetry tags and fast rollback path.
Motivation: an incident (SUP-7890) revealed oscillation when tenants were abruptly evicted during partial regional egress congestion. This PR introduces a lattice-based isolation model and an SLO Escort component to make evictions progressive, observable, and reversible without violating high-tier SLOs. Summary of changes: 1) isolation/lattice_manager: new lattice state machine that tracks tenant posture across soft, probationary, and hardened eviction levels; transitions are timeboxed and instrumented with causality IDs; 2) isolation/policy_evaluator: new scoring hook that computes a degradability score combining token-rate, latency quantiles, and recent KV pressure; 3) sleight-of-hand SLO Escort: a lightweight orchestrator that carries SLO priority markers across routing/region-fallback decisions so we avoid demoting high-priority tenants during transient egress spikes; 4) telemetry: add slo_escort_{decision,reason} metrics and a traceability tag for tenant lattice transitions; 5) tests and a fast rollback feature flag (FF_ISOLATION_LATTICE) to revert to previous behavior if needed. Checklist: [x] unit tests for lattice transitions, [x] integration test for region failover path, [x] CI smoke validated, [x] telemetry dashboards added, [x] feature-flag gating and documented rollback steps, [ ] docs: expanded operational runbook (follow-up small PR). Risk/rollout: gated behind FF_ISOLATION_LATTICE and staged rollout to a single region for 24h canary. Related: ENG-2345 for long-term scheduler work and PM-412 for customer impact tracking. Links: incident SUP-7890, runbook: internal/runbooks/soft-degrade.md. Why unique: lattice model decouples tenant health from immediate eviction decisions and the Escort ensures SLO priorities persist across routing fallback so a regional failover does not cascade demotions.
Diego Marquez: Nice approach. Two questions: 1) how is the lattice persisted across restarts? 2) can the SLO Escort marker leak into logs causing PII risks?
Priya Anand: Answered - lattice state is lightweight and persisted to existing tenant-meta KV with TTL; added a migration guard to avoid heavy writes. Escort tags are opaque IDs and will not contain tenant identifiers; added an extra audit gate to the telemetry writer as requested.
Hannah Li: Request change - add a 5s debounce before promoting from probationary -> hardened to avoid flip-flopping. Also please add a unit test for the debounce window.
Priya Anand: Updated policy_evaluator with 5s promotion debounce and added TestLatticePromotionDebounce in lattice_test.go. CI green locally.
Arun Patel: Approved after the debounce test and telemetry tag audit. (LGTM)
